headline: Rate increased while power dropped
explanation: During Work 2 (08:25-08:45) the average stroke rate rose from 28.4 spm to 29.8 spm while average power fell from 165.5 W to 157.3 W (candidate-work-2-concept2). In the later Work 3 window (16:45-17:05) power rose to 215.3 W at 30.4 spm (candidate-work-3-concept2). Calibrated frontal video did not reveal a visible cause; Pegasus visual analysis for intervals 2 vs 3 and 2 vs 4 reported unresolved differences (pegasus-interval-2-vs-3-visual-unresolved, pegasus-interval-2-vs-4-visual-unresolved).
cue: Add a stroke per minute only after confirming power stays at or above the starting average.
drill: Repeat a short work segment at the current rate, then add one stroke per minute only while watts remain at or above the starting average.
successCriterion: Power remains at or above the starting average after the rate increase.
limitation: The fixed frontal video cannot measure force or explain the telemetry difference; failure to resolve a difference does not mean the mechanics were identical.
